findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation "Give every custom control an accessible name…" lacks a specific data anchor (no selector, count or page reference).
Priority 2 recommendation to raise contrast ratio is generic and not tied to any identified element or instance count.
Priority 3 recommendation about exposing structure uses no selector or specific instance data.
Priority 4 recommendation to review flagged instances lacks a concrete reference to the affected elements.
Priority 5 recommendation for alt text does not specify which images are missing alt attributes.
Priority 6 recommendation to order headings without skipping levels is not anchored to any specific heading hierarchy instance.
Priority 7 recommendation to wrap primary content in a <main> landmark does not reference the page or element count.
Priority 8 recommendation to replace landmark containers with semantic elements lacks selector or instance details.
Priority 10 recommendation to add Schema.org properties is generic and not tied to a specific entity type or missing property list.
Priority 11 recommendation to publish llms.txt does not specify the file path or confirm its absence in audit data.
Priority 12 recommendation to publish sitemap.xml is generic and lacks a specific reference to the missing file location.
